roster.name: Minimum Information About a Bioactive Entity (MIABE)
roster.description: A community reporting guideline / checklist for describing bioactive entities (small molecules, therapeutic proteins, peptides, antibodies, carbohydrates) and their interactions in pre-clinical publications or data depositions. Specifies the minimum metadata fields to report (chemical identity, assay details, activity measurements, targets, provenance) to enable reproducibility, curation and data mining; non-prescriptive (not an SOP).

roster.name: PSI-MI (PSI-MI XML 2.5 schema and controlled vocabulary)
roster.description: An XML schema and accompanying controlled vocabulary for representing molecular interaction data (including drug–target/interactor information). Designed as a standardized data-exchange format to facilitate transfer of interaction data between databases and LIMS systems; the MIABE seed material explicitly references PSI‑MI and its CV terms extended to describe drugs and targets.
